lines.text: Wanna go to the late show?
I'm tired, so count me out.

data.define: Used to politely say you won't join a plan.

example.text: I'm tired, so count me out.

misuse.text: Don't say 'count me out' to your boss's request.
misuse.why: It sounds like a flat refusal.

data.l1_hook: ¿Quieres ir al espectáculo nocturno? 'Count me out'.
data.l1_ex: Estoy cansado, así que "count me out".

native.tip: “count me out” = no cuentes conmigo. Ejemplo: “I'm tired, so count me out.”
